module.title: Identity Proofing, Assertions and Fraud Controls
module.business_purpose: Verifies patients, practitioners, representatives and organization operators against authoritative ministries, civil registries, professional boards and government data platforms. Generic integration retries remain in integrations; these tables preserve identity-specific evidence, checks and decisions.
